subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should after-compaction hooks permanently expose only resetSession(reason?) for their current canonical session, or must OpenClaw also support the unshipped explicit-key compatibility form?
rationale: This adds a compatibility-sensitive plugin API and session mutation capability; repository policy requires an owner decision before establishing or preserving parallel call signatures.

options.title: Ship the scoped API
options.body: Expose only resetSession(reason?) on eligible after-compaction contexts and remove the unshipped explicit-key overload before merge.

options.title: Adopt explicit-key compatibility
options.body: Keep the legacy form only with an exact documented signature, runtime parity for every allowed call, focused compatibility tests, and a deprecation plan.

options.title: Withhold the API
options.body: Keep hooks observational until a narrower owner-approved session lifecycle extension is designed.

recommendation.title: Ship the scoped API
recommendation.body: Expose only resetSession(reason?) on eligible after-compaction contexts and remove the unshipped explicit-key overload before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available current-main ownership signal is recent work on the shared session-reset lifecycle used by every proposed hook path.
